about.heading: PT KMK Plastics Indonesia
about.description:
PT. KMK Plastics Indonesia is a leading company specializing in the provision of high-quality plastic components, with expertise in injection molding, printing, painting, and assembly processes. We are also actively involved in the manufacturing, maintenance, modification, and repair of molds to international standards.

We are committed to delivering innovative and efficient manufacturing solutions to our clients, ensuring that each product meets the highest expectations of quality and reliability.
about.secondaryDescription: With extensive experience and support from the latest technology, we are ready to meet your business needs and become a trusted partner in the plastic manufacturing industry.
